sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) BETWEEN 1 AND 64), "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 80), "type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('income', 'expense')), "icon_key" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(icon_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 64), "color_hex" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(color_hex) = 7 AND substr(color_hex, 1, 1) = '#' AND substr(color_hex, 2) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-Fa-f]*'), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (typeof(sort_order) = 'integer' AND sort_order >= 0), "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE CHECK (is_archived IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "currencies" ("code" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(code) = 3 AND code NOT GLOB '*[^A-Z]*'), "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 80), "symbol" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(symbol)) BETWEEN 1 AND 12), "decimal_places" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(decimal_places) = 'integer' AND decimal_places BETWEEN 0 AND 6), "rate_to_myr" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(rate_to_myr) BETWEEN 1 AND 25 AND rate_to_myr NOT GLOB '*[^0-9.]*' AND rate_to_myr GLOB '*[1-9]*' AND substr(rate_to_myr, 1, 1) <> '.' AND substr(rate_to_myr, -1) <> '.' AND(length(rate_to_myr) = 1 OR substr(rate_to_myr, 1, 1) <> '0' OR substr(rate_to_myr, 2, 1) = '.')AND(instr(rate_to_myr, '.') = 0 AND length(rate_to_myr) <= 12 OR instr(rate_to_myr, '.') BETWEEN 2 AND 13 AND length(rate_to_myr) - instr(rate_to_myr, '.') BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND substr(rate_to_myr, instr(rate_to_myr, '.') + 1) NOT GLOB '*.*')), "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE CHECK (is_active IN (0, 1)), "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(created_at_utc) = 'integer' AND created_at_utc >= 0), "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(updated_at_utc) = 'integer' AND updated_at_utc >= created_at_utc), CHECK(code <> 'MYR' OR(decimal_places = 2 AND rate_to_myr = '1' AND is_active = 1)));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "trips" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) BETWEEN 1 AND 64), "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 80));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "trip_rates" ("trip_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES trips(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES currencies(code)ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE, "rate_to_myr" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(rate_to_myr) BETWEEN 1 AND 25 AND rate_to_myr NOT GLOB '*[^0-9.]*' AND rate_to_myr GLOB '*[1-9]*' AND substr(rate_to_myr, 1, 1) <> '.' AND substr(rate_to_myr, -1) <> '.' AND(length(rate_to_myr) = 1 OR substr(rate_to_myr, 1, 1) <> '0' OR substr(rate_to_myr, 2, 1) = '.')AND(instr(rate_to_myr, '.') = 0 AND length(rate_to_myr) <= 12 OR instr(rate_to_myr, '.') BETWEEN 2 AND 13 AND length(rate_to_myr) - instr(rate_to_myr, '.') BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND substr(rate_to_myr, instr(rate_to_myr, '.') + 1) NOT GLOB '*.*')), PRIMARY KEY(trip_id, currency_code), CHECK(currency_code <> 'MYR'));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) = 36 AND substr(id, 9, 1) = '-' AND substr(id, 14, 1) = '-' AND substr(id, 19, 1) = '-' AND substr(id, 24, 1) = '-' AND length("replace"(id, '-', '')) = 32 AND "replace"(id, '-', '') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-Fa-f]*'), "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES categories(id)ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('income', 'expense')), "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(amount_minor) = 'integer' AND amount_minor > 0), "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES currencies(code)ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "exchange_rate_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(exchange_rate_snapshot) BETWEEN 1 AND 25 AND exchange_rate_snapshot NOT GLOB '*[^0-9.]*' AND exchange_rate_snapshot GLOB '*[1-9]*' AND substr(exchange_rate_snapshot, 1, 1) <> '.' AND substr(exchange_rate_snapshot, -1) <> '.' AND(length(exchange_rate_snapshot) = 1 OR substr(exchange_rate_snapshot, 1, 1) <> '0' OR substr(exchange_rate_snapshot, 2, 1) = '.')AND(instr(exchange_rate_snapshot, '.') = 0 AND length(exchange_rate_snapshot) <= 12 OR instr(exchange_rate_snapshot, '.') BETWEEN 2 AND 13 AND length(exchange_rate_snapshot) - instr(exchange_rate_snapshot, '.') BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND substr(exchange_rate_snapshot, instr(exchange_rate_snapshot, '.') + 1) NOT GLOB '*.*')), "amount_myr_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(amount_myr_minor) = 'integer' AND amount_myr_minor >= 0), "transaction_date" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (transaction_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND transaction_date BETWEEN '0001-01-01' AND '9999-12-31' AND date(transaction_date, '+0 days') IS NOT NULL AND date(transaction_date, '+0 days') = transaction_date), "note" TEXT CHECK (note IS NULL OR length(note) <= 2000), "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(created_at_utc) = 'integer' AND created_at_utc >= 0), "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(updated_at_utc) = 'integer' AND updated_at_utc >= created_at_utc), "trip_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'personal' REFERENCES trips(id), CHECK(currency_code <> 'MYR' OR(exchange_rate_snapshot = '1' AND amount_myr_minor = amount_minor)));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length("key") BETWEEN 1 AND 80), "value" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(value) <= 4000));
CREATE INDEX transactions_trip_date_idx ON transactions (trip_id, transaction_date DESC, id)
CREATE INDEX transactions_date_idx ON transactions (transaction_date DESC, id)
CREATE INDEX transactions_category_date_idx ON transactions (category_id, transaction_date)
CREATE INDEX transactions_currency_date_idx ON transactions (currency_code, transaction_date)
CREATE INDEX transactions_type_date_idx ON transactions (type, transaction_date)
CREATE TRIGGER protect_myr_delete BEFORE DELETE ON currencies WHEN OLD.code = 'MYR' BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'MYR cannot be deleted');END
CREATE TRIGGER protect_myr_code BEFORE UPDATE OF code ON currencies WHEN OLD.code = 'MYR' AND NEW.code <> OLD.code BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'MYR code cannot change');END

CREATE TRIGGER protect_used_currency BEFORE UPDATE OF code, decimal_places ON currencies WHEN(NEW.code <> OLD.code OR NEW.decimal_places <> OLD.decimal_places)AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM transactions WHERE currency_code = OLD.code) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'Used currency code and precision cannot change');END

CREATE TRIGGER protect_used_category_type BEFORE UPDATE OF type ON categories WHEN NEW.type <> OLD.type AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM transactions WHERE category_id = OLD.id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'Used category type cannot change');END

CREATE TRIGGER validate_transaction_insert BEFORE INSERT ON transactions WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM categories WHERE id = NEW.category_id AND type = NEW.type) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'Transaction category must match its type');END

CREATE TRIGGER validate_transaction_update BEFORE UPDATE OF category_id, type ON transactions WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM categories WHERE id = NEW.category_id AND type = NEW.type) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'Transaction category must match its type');END
